flip_candidates.mechanism_en: The SDK honours `Options.managedSettings.modelPricing` whole (past the restrictive filter) whenever `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` is set on the spawn — reachable at the lifted bundle: `modelPricing` scores 10 in `sdk.mjs`, 2 in `sdk.d.ts`, 28 in the native binary at 0.3.247, negative control `nessyNotARealSdkKey` 0.
flip_candidates.reason_en: One env var on the claude spawn would make the child's own cost figures agree with the host's, and the price table already exists (`packages/shared/src/config/managed-model-prices.ts` symbol `priceUsageWithManagedTable`); the only cost is the one the owner weighed — the same flag strips `model`/`fallbackModel`/`modelPicker`/`modelOverrides` from the admin tiers and filters their `env`.

flip_candidates.mechanism_en: The vendored claude binary now reads the variable itself: `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES` scores 4 in the native `claude` and 1 in `sdk.mjs` at 0.3.247 / 2.1.247 (0 at 2.1.233; negative control `nessyNotARealSdkKey` 0, positive control `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` 22/3), computing `(V.CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES ?? <default>) * 60000` behind its own `tengu_saffron_wren` gate beside a 'Goal check-in: background work no longer running' string.
flip_candidates.reason_en: The refusal's stated premise — 'there is nothing native to enable on claude' — is exactly what the lift falsified, and the residue is a live divergence rather than a naming preference: the claude child inherits the vendor name through the spawn's `process.env` spread, so an operator who sets `NESSY_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES` has configured the host's check-in and not the runtime's own.

flip_candidates.mechanism_en: `UnlessTrusted` — the routing `untrusted` used to give us — still exists at `rust-v0.150.1` and is selected natively by `core/src/config/mod.rs` when `active_project.is_untrusted()`; it is the one arm of `core/src/exec_policy.rs`'s table that answers `Prompt` for a non-dangerous command under an unrestricted sandbox, where `Never`, `OnRequest` and `Granular(_)` all answer `Allow`.
flip_candidates.reason_en: Reachable host-side by marking the project untrusted, so the floor the sandbox-off default lost could be bought back without building a second source of truth — but it asserts a trust state we do not mean and upstream also uses that state to withhold project-level `AGENTS.md`, which is why the owner took the documented default instead; recorded so the route is not rediscovered as a gap.

flip_candidates.mechanism_en: The three siblings ship inside the same upstream release archive `scripts/fetch-codex.mjs` already downloads and verifies against `codex-package_SHA256SUMS`: at `rust-v0.150.1` the package is `codex-package.json` + `bin/codex-app-server` + `bin/codex-code-mode-host` + `codex-path/rg` + `codex-resources/zsh/bin/zsh`, and symbol `fetchTarget` extracts only the app-server.
flip_candidates.reason_en: Extending `fetchTarget`'s extraction list plus dmg staging, with a per-file `binarySha256` pin exactly as the Windows trio already has, is S (+dmg); the refusal buys dmg size for surfaces the fork does not expose and costs an operator who turns on the `[features]` keys for shell snapshot, file search or code mode a capability with no binary behind it.
